entry.expr_help_intro: Filter entries by label presence or value. Combine with AND / OR, negate with NOT, change precedence with parentheses.
entry.expr_help_row_lplus_ne: Neither directly L4 nor inherited L4
entry.expr_help_row_lplus_eq: Owned L4 value equals V1 (including inherited)
entry.expr_help_inherit_intro: A + after a label includes inherited / overridden relationships:
entry.expr_help_inherit_body: After declaring a relationship in «Settings · Labels», a label can pull other labels in (inherit) or be pulled out (override). Without +, only directly applied labels match.
entry.expr_help_keyonly_intro: Only labels whose key is inherited (value not propagated) support existence checks like L4+ / !L4+, not equality or comparison.
entry.expr_help_meta_intro: Built-in metadata: Code / Title / CreatedAt / UpdatedAt (these names cannot be used as custom labels).
entry.expr_help_tip: Tip: type / in the input to pick from built-in metadata and this view's existing labels; Enter applies the expression, Escape closes the hint. For time labels (including CreatedAt / UpdatedAt), follow with a comparison operator and a space (space between key and operator is optional),
entry.timeline_kind_mismatch: Start and end must be the same kind of time label (both date-bearing or both pure time); leaving either blank disables the timeline.

automation.title: Automation rules
automation.description: Triggered when a label is written. Use $label / $old / $new in the trigger to refer to the current change, or use the label name directly (e.g. Priority >= 3) to test the post-write state of the source entry.
automation.trigger_help: Keywords: $label (name of the changed label), $old (old value; !$old for new), $new (new value; !$new for delete).

settings.title: Label definitions (LabelSchema)

settings.audit.title: Audit log

settings.danger.deleted_hint: Entries, labels, views, members are all preserved; restoring brings it back to the workspace list immediately.
settings.danger.delete_desc: Soft delete: the workspace moves to the «Trash» in the workspace list. All data is preserved and can be restored anytime.
settings.danger.transfer_desc: After transfer, {email} becomes Owner and you become Maintainer. They can transfer back.

settings.links_help: Inherit: when the target label takes a value, this row shows the same value. Override: when the target label takes a value, this row shows another value. Either side may leave the value empty — meaning only "has any value" is constrained.
settings.readonly_hint: Built-in labels or insufficient permissions — links are view-only.
